title: Reactive feedback for suppression of the periodic transient beam loading effect in storage rings: theory and simulations
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, submitted to Physical Review Accelerators and Beams
summary: In fourth-generation synchrotron light sources, harmonic cavities are often employed for bunch lengthening. The reduced longitudinal focusing, combined with high total $R/Q$ of these cavities, can make the beam susceptible to the periodic transient beam loading (PTBL) effect, a multibunch instability characterized by slow oscillations in bunch centroids and lengths and by its resistance to conventional feedback damping. In this work, building on a recent proposal of applying reactive feedback to control the PTBL effect, we developed a frequency-domain theoretical model, including the feedback voltage in the linearized Vlasov equation to derive a Lebedev equation modified by the feedback transfer function. The reactive feedback was also implemented in the time domain in the macroparticle tracking code \texttt{STABLE}. The methods were applied to the parameters of the double-rf system of the MAX IV storage ring. Both approaches show that, above a threshold gain, an idealized pure reactive feedback is able to suppress the PTBL effect, with good agreement between theory and simulations across beam currents and $R/Q$ values. Realistic hardware limitations were included in the analysis, determining the limits for feedback gain, latency, and bandwidth, which are compatible with existing bunch-by-bunch feedback systems. Using the HALF storage ring parameters, the semi-analytical results indicate that the reactive feedback can be extended to suppress the PTBL effect in triple-rf systems, albeit at higher threshold gains than for double-rf systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立频域理论模型并在STABLE中实现时间域仿真，研究纯无功反馈对第四代同步辐射光源中周期性瞬态束流负载（PTBL）多束团不稳定性的抑制效果，并评估硬件限制及在三射频系统中的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 谐波腔用于束团拉长，但会降低纵向聚焦；结合高总R/Q，束流易受PTBL影响。PTBL表现为束团质心和长度的慢振荡，且难以被常规反馈阻尼。作者基于近期提出的无功反馈控制PTBL方案，旨在建立理论模型和仿真方法，系统评估其抑制效果与实际可行性。
AI.method: 将反馈电压纳入线性化Vlasov方程，建立频域理论模型，推导出由反馈传递函数修正的Lebedev方程；同时在宏粒子跟踪代码STABLE中以时间域实现无功反馈。将方法应用于MAX IV储存环双射频系统参数，并分析实际硬件限制对反馈增益、延迟和带宽的影响；进一步使用HALF储存环参数进行半解析分析，考察三射频系统中的适用性。
AI.result: 两种方法均表明，当增益超过阈值时，理想纯无功反馈能够抑制PTBL；在广泛束流电流和R/Q取值下，理论与仿真吻合良好。纳入实际硬件限制后，分析给出了反馈增益、延迟和带宽的界限，且这些界限与现有逐束团反馈系统兼容。基于HALF参数的半解析结果表明，无功反馈可扩展用于抑制三射频系统中的PTBL，但阈值增益高于双射频系统。
AI.conclusion: 无功反馈是一种可抑制双射频系统PTBL的有效方案，并在三射频系统中具有扩展潜力；其所需增益、延迟和带宽在现有逐束团反馈系统可兼容范围内。理论模型与STABLE仿真结果一致，为评估实际系统实施提供了依据。

title: Few-Ion Schottky Power Scaling and Automated Reconstruction of Single-Ion Events
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, submitted to JPS Conference Proceedings
summary: Non-destructive Schottky diagnostics at heavy-ion storage rings is broadly exploited to measure revolution frequencies and intensities of stored ions. The mean Schottky power of incoherent stored ions is expected to be proportional to their number. An empirical examination of this response in few-ion populations is important for interpreting individual occupancy changes. We present an automated staircase reconstruction of the power in a selected frequency band of time-resolved Schottky spectra. The procedure was applied to 7008 selected injections recorded with a resonant cavity pickup at the Experimental Storage Ring at GSI during an experiment on the nuclear two-photon decay of the first excited $0^+$ state in bare $^{98}\mathrm{Mo}^{42+}$. The distribution of freely fitted level heights exhibits maxima close to integer multiples of a single-ion power scale up to approximately five ions. This is consistent with an approximately additive mean power response under the present measurement conditions. The reconstructed occupancy histories also retain population dwell intervals and resolved disappearance times for subsequent lifetime analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对时间分辨肖特基谱选定频段功率进行自动阶梯重构的方法，并用于GSI实验储存环中7008次选定注入的数据；结果显示少离子条件下功率响应近似可加，且重构的占据历史可用于寿命分析。
AI.motivation: 非破坏性肖特基诊断常用于测量储存离子的回旋频率和强度，非相干储存离子的平均肖特基功率预期与其数目成正比；为解释单个占据数变化，需要在少离子群体中对该响应进行经验检验。
AI.method: 采用自动阶梯重构方法，提取时间分辨肖特基谱中选定频段的功率；将该流程应用于GSI实验储存环共振腔拾取器记录的7008次选定注入，实验涉及裸^98Mo^42+第一激发0+态的核双光子衰变。
AI.result: 自由拟合所得能级高度分布的最大值接近单离子功率尺度的整数倍，最多约至5个离子；这与当前测量条件下平均功率响应近似可加相一致。重构的占据历史还保留了布居停留区间和可分辨的消失时间，供后续寿命分析使用。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在所给测量条件下少离子肖特基平均功率响应近似可加，且该自动阶梯重构方法能够提供用于后续寿命分析的占据历史、停留区间和消失时间信息。

title: LHC Based Antimuon-Nucleus Collider LH$μ$C: Nucleus Options
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Presented at the Workshop on Ultra-cold Muons for the LHC, Kraków, Poland, 24-26 September 2026
summary: Nucleus options of the LH$μ$C, an antimuon-hadron collider based on the LHC, are presented. Ultra-cold $μ^+$ beams, based on the technology of the J-PARC muon $g-2$/EDM experiment as proposed for $μ$TRISTAN, are accelerated to 1 TeV in either a $μ$TRISTAN-type booster or a booster housed in the LH$e$C energy-recovery-linac tunnel, and collide with LHC nucleus beams in a 3 km main ring tangential to the LHC. Collisions with Pb, Xe, O and Ne beams provide centre-of-mass energies from 13.1 to 47.9 TeV, i.e. about 3.3 TeV per nucleon. Luminosities and beam-beam tune shifts are evaluated with the AloHEP software. For $μ$-Pb collisions, the luminosity reaches $2.7\times10^{30}$ ($2.2\times10^{30}$) cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$ with the $μ$TRISTAN-type (ERL-based) booster, i.e. $5.6\times10^{32}$ ($4.5\times10^{32}$) cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$ per nucleon, which a Brinkmann-Dohlus dynamic focusing scheme could increase by a factor of 2-3. The physics potential is discussed, including an extension of the kinematic reach by a factor of about 20 with respect to the LH$e$C, access to parton saturation at perturbative scales, nuclear parton distributions, photon-induced processes and charged-current flavour separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于 LHC 的反 μ 子-强子对撞机 LHμC 的核束选项：用超冷 μ+ 束加速到 1 TeV，并与 LHC 的 Pb、Xe、O、Ne 核束碰撞，评估其亮度、束束效应及物理潜力。
AI.motivation: 利用 μLHC 型设施开展 μ+ 与原子核碰撞，扩展相对于 LHeC 的运动学覆盖，并研究部分子饱和、核部分子分布、光子诱导过程及带电流味分离等物理。
AI.method: 采用 J-PARC μ 子 g-2/EDM 实验所提出、并用于 μTRISTAN 的超冷 μ+ 束技术，将 μ+ 加速至 1 TeV；加速器可采用 μTRISTAN 型增强器，或置于 LHeC 能量回收直线加速器隧道中的增强器。μ+ 束与 LHC 核束在一条与 LHC 相切的 3 km 主环中碰撞。核束包括 Pb、Xe、O 和 Ne。使用 AloHEP 软件评估亮度和束束调谐频移。
AI.result: 碰撞质心能量为 13.1–47.9 TeV，约每核子 3.3 TeV。对于 μ-Pb 碰撞，μTRISTAN 型增强器方案亮度达 2.7×10^30 cm^-2 s^-1，ERL 型增强器方案为 2.2×10^30 cm^-2 s^-1；按每核子计分别为 5.6×10^32 和 4.5×10^32 cm^-2 s^-1。Brinkmann-Dohlus 动态聚焦方案可再将亮度提高 2–3 倍。
AI.conclusion: LHμC 的核选项可提供 TeV 量级每核子的 μ+–核碰撞和较高亮度，并具有扩展运动学覆盖、探测微扰尺度部分子饱和、研究核部分子分布、光子诱导过程及带电流味分离的物理潜力；摘要未给出明确的总体工程可行性、成本或时间表结论。

title: Quantum phase estimation on a Rydberg quantum simulator
summary: Determining the energy spectrum of a many-body quantum system is a central goal of quantum physics. Ground-state energies underpin materials science and quantum chemistry, whereas excited states govern dynamical phenomena such as quantum thermalization. Quantum simulators have greatly shaped our understanding of many-body systems, for example, by enabling access to microscopic mechanisms and nonlocal order parameters. However, experiments still struggle to access the full range of many-body spectral features and are typically limited to measuring energy gaps and excitations by spectroscopic means. Here, we address this challenge by demonstrating quantum phase estimation on an analog Rydberg quantum simulator. We reconstruct the complex-valued return amplitude, or Loschmidt echo, of an initial probe state. From its Fourier transform, we measure absolute ground-state energies and energy gaps in systems of up to 19 atoms in one and two spatial dimensions. Varying the initial probe state, we select distinct spectral windows within which we compute the longitudinal and transverse magnetization, and observe their competition across the many-body spectrum. Our results thereby demonstrate phase-sensitive many-body spectroscopy on an analog quantum simulator without auxiliary qubits or controlled evolution.

AI.tldr: 该工作在模拟Rydberg量子模拟器上实现量子相位估计，通过重建探针态的复值Loschmidt回波并作傅里叶变换，测量多体系统的绝对基态能量与能隙，并演示可选择谱窗口的相位敏感多体谱学。
AI.motivation: 多体量子系统的能谱是量子物理的核心目标：基态能量支撑材料科学与量子化学，激发态决定量子热化等动力学现象。现有量子模拟器虽能研究多体机制和非局域序参量，但实验上仍难以获取完整的多体谱特征，通常只能通过谱学手段测量能隙和激发。
AI.method: 在模拟Rydberg量子模拟器上执行量子相位估计；重建初始探针态的复值返回振幅（Loschmidt回波），并利用其傅里叶变换提取能谱信息；在一维和二维、最多19个原子的系统中测量绝对基态能量和能隙；通过改变初始探针态选择不同谱窗口，并在其中计算纵向和横向磁化；该方法无需辅助量子比特或受控演化。
AI.result: 测量了最多19个原子的一维和二维系统中的绝对基态能量与能隙；在不同谱窗口内计算纵向和横向磁化，并观察到二者跨多体谱的竞争。摘要未提供具体测量精度、误差指标或可扩展性定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明可在模拟量子模拟器上实现相位敏感的多体谱学，且无需辅助量子比特或受控演化。

title: 1.56 THz Full-Field Rydberg-Atom Imaging with 0.3 mm-scale Spatial Response
summary: THz imaging via Rydberg-atom up-conversion offers a powerful full-field modality with high sensitivity and rapid acquisition. However sub-millimeter imaging above 1 THz is still constrained by source power and beam-delivery loss. In this paper, we demonstrate a \(50~\mathrm{mm} \times 50~\mathrm{mm}\) full-field imaging at 1.56~THz by implementing the \(11P_{3/2} \rightarrow 10D_{5/2}\) transition of a cesium Rydberg-atom vapor. The measured spatial response FWHMs are \(0.314~\mathrm{mm}\) in horizontal and \(0.354~\mathrm{mm}\) in vertical for a \(0.5~\mathrm{mm}\) pinhole, alongside a sensitivity of \(31.7~\mathrm{fW}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1/2}/(6.5 \times 6.5)~μ\mathrm{m}^{2}\), and a frame rate up to \(300~\mathrm{fps}\). Under matched illumination, relay, and image-processing conditions, mask imaging at 1.56 THz reproduces finer features and edges with substantially higher edge contrast, deeper intensity-trough separation in line profiles, and recovered detail that remains blurred or unresolved at 0.55 THz. Furthermore, preliminary imaging of a \(200~μ\mathrm{m}\) tissue slice suggests morphological correspondence with H\&E histology histology, offered as a proof-of-concept for label-free tissue characterization. By validating the wavelength-dependent resolution scaling in Rydberg THz imaging, this work establishes frequency scaling as a general design principle for sub-millimeter Rydberg-THz imaging.

AI.tldr: 该文利用铯里德堡原子蒸气的11P3/2→10D5/2跃迁，在1.56 THz实现50 mm×50 mm全视场成像，空间响应FWHM约0.314 mm（水平）和0.354 mm（垂直），灵敏度31.7 fW·s^-1/2/(6.5×6.5 μm²)，帧率最高300 fps；相较0.55 THz，1.56 THz可呈现更细特征、更高边缘对比和更深的线剖面强度谷分离，并初步展示200 μm组织切片与H&E组织学的形态学对应，支持将频率缩放作为亚毫米里德堡THz成像的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 里德堡原子上转换THz成像具有高灵敏度、快速采集和全视场成像优势，但1 THz以上的亚毫米成像仍受源功率和光束传输损耗限制，需要验证更高频率下的成像分辨率与设计规律。
AI.method: 采用铯里德堡原子蒸气的11P3/2→10D5/2跃迁，在1.56 THz实现50 mm×50 mm全视场成像；对0.5 mm针孔测得空间响应FWHM为水平0.314 mm、垂直0.354 mm，灵敏度为31.7 fW·s^-1/2/(6.5×6.5 μm²)，帧率最高300 fps；在匹配照明、中继和图像处理条件下，对比1.56 THz与0.55 THz的掩模成像，并对200 μm组织切片进行初步成像及与H&E组织学对照。
AI.result: 1.56 THz掩模成像相较0.55 THz呈现更细特征和边缘、更高边缘对比、线剖面中更深的强度谷分离，并恢复0.55 THz下模糊或未分辨的细节；200 μm组织切片的初步成像显示与H&E组织学存在形态学对应，作为无标记组织表征的概念验证。摘要未提供组织诊断的定量性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 验证了里德堡THz成像中分辨率随波长变化的缩放行为，并将频率缩放确立为亚毫米里德堡THz成像的一般设计原则。

title: A trap-based platform for cooling and laser spectroscopy of fast ions toward radioactive-ion applications
summary: We report on the first experiments with the Stopping and Trapping of Radioactive Isotopes for Precision Experiments (STRIPE) segmented linear Paul trap. The intent for this apparatus is to serve as an efficient capture and laser-cooling trap for radioactive isotopes produced at radioactive ion beam facilities. We demonstrate the deceleration of 10 keV ion beams and their trapping and laser cooling into Coulomb crystals. As an initial spectroscopic benchmark, the dipole-forbidden $5s$ $^2S_{1/2}$ $\rightarrow$ $4d$ $^2D_{5/2}$ transition in $^{88}$Sr$^+$ was driven, partially resolving the Zeeman structure and yielding a Gaussian linewidth of 14.5(8) MHz, with the residual width attributed to the ions' micromotion. The lifetime of the metastable $4d$ $^2D_{5/2}$ state was measured to be 0.325(5)$_{\mathrm{stat}}$(4)$_{\mathrm{sys}}$ s, uncorrected for collisional quenching. Several measurements to quantify the cooling timescale, the detection rate of the photon collection region and the trap storage lifetime were also performed. The developed technique will allow radioactive ion beams to be decelerated and cooled for precision spectroscopy measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文首次报道了STRIPE分段线性保罗阱的实验结果，实现了10 keV离子束的减速、俘获和激光冷却至库仑晶体，并以^88Sr^+的偶极禁戒跃迁作为光谱基准，测量了谱线宽度、亚稳态寿命及若干阱性能参数。
AI.motivation: 为放射性离子束设施提供高效的俘获与激光冷却装置，从而对放射性同位素开展精密光谱测量。
AI.method: 采用STRIPE分段线性保罗阱减速10 keV离子束，将其俘获并激光冷却至库仑晶体；驱动^88Sr^+的5s ^2S_{1/2}→4d ^2D_{5/2}偶极禁戒跃迁进行光谱基准测试，并测量冷却时间尺度、光子收集区域探测率和阱储存寿命等参数。
AI.result: 成功演示了10 keV离子束的减速、俘获和激光冷却；该跃迁被驱动并部分分辨Zeeman结构，高斯线宽为14.5(8) MHz，剩余宽度归因于离子微运动；4d ^2D_{5/2}亚稳态寿命测得为0.325(5)_stat(4)_sys s，未校正碰撞猝灭。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的技术可实现放射性离子束的减速与冷却，为精密光谱测量提供可行途径。

title: A Surrogate Boundary Condition for Improved Accuracy and Performance of Local Modeling in Radiation Transport Simulations
summary: Monte Carlo neutronics analysis of tokamak designs is computationally expensive due to the complex CAD geometries required to accurately model them. Design iteration of port plugs using global transport in the full model is impractical because of the computational cost. To circumvent this, local modeling methods are used. In the local modeling method, a boundary condition is assumed on the port plug, such that particles that leave the port plug do not require transport in the surrounding global model. For this purpose, vacuum and reflective boundaries are assumed, both of which provide poor approximation of the true transport physics in the global model. To improve on current techniques, a surrogate model is presented that provides a physics-informed boundary condition for the component. A neural network is trained to reproduce the boundary condition on the component that represents the behavior of particles returning from the surrounding geometry. Monte Carlo transport is only necessary within the component, and approximate physics from the surrounding region are retained. This approach allows the design in the component to be iterated without requiring full model transport and joining of the component mesh to the global mesh in each iteration. In this work, the surrogate model is evaluated against vacuum and reflective boundaries-- outperforming both in accuracy, with surrogate predictions of the flux in the port plug differing less than 12% from the global transport solution in any given energy bin. The surrogate boundary condition is also demonstrated to be more performant than global transport for the simplified benchmark geometry.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于神经网络的物理知情边界条件代理模型，用于托卡马克端口插件的中子学局部建模，在仅对部件内部进行蒙特卡罗输运的情况下，较真空/反射边界更准确地复现全局输运结果，并在简化基准几何上优于全局输运的计算性能。
AI.motivation: 托卡马克中子学全局蒙特卡罗分析因复杂CAD几何而计算昂贵，使用全模型全局输运进行端口插件设计迭代不切实际；现有局部建模采用真空或反射边界，无法良好近似全局模型中的真实输运物理，因此需要更准确的部件边界条件。
AI.method: 构建代理模型为端口插件提供物理知情边界条件；训练神经网络复现部件边界条件，以表征粒子从周围几何返回部件的行为；蒙特卡罗输运仅在部件内部进行，同时保留周围区域的近似物理；该方法使部件设计可迭代而无需每次进行全模型输运及将部件网格与全局网格拼接；并在简化基准几何上与真空边界、反射边界及全局输运进行比较评估。
AI.result: 代理模型在精度上优于真空和反射边界；端口插件通量的代理预测在任一能量 bins 中与全局输运解的差异小于12%；在简化基准几何上，代理边界条件也比全局输运更具计算性能。摘要未给出具体加速比或更详细的计算成本数据。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，神经网络安全边界条件可在局部建模中保留周围区域的近似输运物理，避免全模型输运和重复网格拼接，从而支持端口插件设计迭代，并在所评估的简化基准中同时提升边界条件精度与计算性能；其结论主要基于该简化基准几何，摘要未提供更广泛几何或完整托卡马克模型的验证结果。

title: CGTransformer: A Topology-Aware Autoregressive Framework for Crystal Generation and Inverse Design
summary: Autoregressive language models offer a unified route to crystal generation and inverse design, but their performance depends on how periodic structures are serialized. Symmetry equivalent and closely related crystals can receive different atomic orders under coordinate-based serialization, introducing variability unrelated to their structural connectivity. Here, we present CGTransformer (Crystal Graph Transformer), an autoregressive generative framework that addresses this challenge via a graph-embedded sorting strategy. Using quotientgraph topology and barycentric embeddings, Element Symmetry Graph (ESG) converts periodic crystal networks into topology-guided one-dimensional sequences that retain key local and symmetry-related structural information. CGTransformer achieves high generation validity and the highest single shot crystal structure prediction (CSP) match rate among the compared MP-20 baselines (63.24%), while same backbone comparisons show improved structure recovery over coordinate-based ordering. Furthermore, we demonstrate property-conditioned inverse design for wide-bandgap semiconductors, where ESG achieves a much higher stable, unique and novel (S.U.N.) rate and stronger target-property alignment than the coordinate-based baseline. These results establish topology-guided sequence construction as an effective route to improving crystal generation and property-directed design at fixed model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CGTransformer：利用晶格图拓扑与重心嵌入构建元素对称图（ESG），将周期晶体网络序列化为拓扑引导的一维序列，以改进自回归晶体生成与性质导向逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型可用于统一的晶体生成与逆向设计，但其性能受周期结构序列化方式影响；基于坐标的序列化会使对称等价或结构相近的晶体产生不同原子顺序，从而引入与结构连接性无关的变异性。
AI.method: 提出 CGTransformer 自回归生成框架，并采用图嵌入排序策略；具体通过商图拓扑和重心嵌入构建 Element Symmetry Graph（ESG），将周期晶体网络转换为保留关键局部及对称相关结构信息的拓扑引导一维序列。
AI.result: CGTransformer 取得较高生成有效性，并在所比较的 MP-20 基线中取得最高的单次晶体结构预测（CSP）匹配率（63.24%）；相同骨干网络比较显示，其结构恢复优于基于坐标的排序。针对宽禁带半导体的性质条件逆向设计，ESG 的稳定、独特且新颖（S.U.N.）率显著高于基于坐标的基线，且目标性质对齐更强。摘要未提供 S.U.N. 率等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，拓扑引导的序列构建是在固定模型容量下改进晶体生成与性质导向设计的有效途径。

title: ADfiRe: An empirical- and CFD-informed advection-diffusion-reaction thermal model for wildfire spread
summary: Real-time wildfire forecasting requires a trade-off between rapid yet physically relevant models and high fidelity but computationally costly models of flame spread over heterogeneous, multiphase solid fuel. The present study introduces ADfiRe, a hybrid framework that integrates empirical correlations and CFD-informed parameterizations into a physics-based advection-diffusion-reaction (ADR) formulation. The key features of ADfiRe are the use of established fuel databases, the capacity to handle multiple fuels, and a methodology to capture the effect of arbitrary topography. Furthermore, it includes the effect of flame tilting due to wind, thus accounting for the differences between plume- and wind-dominated fire propagation. ADfiRe resolves explicitly the coupled thermochemical degradation as well as heat and mass transport mechanisms of the advancing fire front. The wind field is modeled based on an appropriately defined Byram number. The model is validated against five well-documented experimental field-scale fires in Mediterranean shrublands, showing quantitative agreement with key metrics such as the rate of spread (ROS) and the fireline intensity, through a two-stage, Arrhenius-based heterogeneous reaction scheme coupling solid-fuel pyrolysis and oxygen-limited char/volatile combustion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了 ADfiRe——一个将经验关联式与 CFD 参数化嵌入物理基平流-扩散-反应（ADR）框架的混合野火蔓延实时预报模型；该模型支持多燃料、任意地形与风致火焰倾斜，并在五个地中海灌木样地野外火烧实验中与蔓延速率和火线强度等指标定量吻合。
AI.motivation: 实时野火预报面临权衡：物理上合理且计算快速的模型与高保真但计算昂贵的模型之间难以兼顾；后者用于描述非均质、多相固体燃料上的火焰蔓延。研究动机即在于构建一个既保留物理机理（耦合热化学降解与传热传质）又能在实时尺度上运行，并能处理多燃料、复杂地形以及风主导与浮力羽流主导两类蔓延情形的框架。
AI.method: ADfiRe 将经验关联式与由 CFD 得到的参数化结果并入基于物理的平流-扩散-反应（ADR）方程体系；其关键特征包括使用既有燃料数据库、支持多燃料、引入可刻画任意地形效应的方法，以及通过恰当定义的 Byram 数来构建风场并计入风致火焰倾斜，从而区分羽流主导与风主导的蔓延。模型显式求解推进火锋处耦合的热化学降解过程以及热量与质量的输运机制，并采用两阶段、基于 Arrhenius 的非均质反应格式，将固体燃料热解与受氧限制的炭/挥发分燃烧相耦合。
AI.result: 模型针对地中海灌木林地的五场有完整记录的野外尺度火烧实验进行验证，在蔓延速率（ROS）与火线强度等关键指标上与实测结果呈定量一致；摘要未给出具体的误差数值、实验场地细节或计算耗时等量化信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将经验关联式与 CFD 参数化嵌入 ADR 物理框架的混合策略，能够在保持物理相关性的同时有效预测非均质燃料与复杂地形、风场条件下的火线蔓延；ADfiRe 具备作为实时野火预报工具的潜力。摘要未讨论模型的适用边界、失败案例或与其他预报系统的对比。

title: Learning and Generating Time Trajectories of Multidimensional Stochastic Processes
summary: We present a multidimensional statistics-informed neural network (SINN) framework for learning and generating trajectories of multicomponent stochastic processes. SINN is built upon a deterministic recurrent neural network that takes streams of white-noise sequences as input and generates ensembles of stochastic trajectories whose statistical properties match those of the underlying stochastic dynamics. While SINN has been demonstrated for various one-dimensional non-Markovian processes, extending it to multidimensional processes is essential for real-world applications. Here, we present key developments toward this goal. First, because direct estimation of multivariate probability density functions (PDFs) becomes computationally challenging with increasing dimension, we represent joint-distribution information using collections of one-dimensional PDFs constructed from linear combinations of the process components. Second, to accommodate the larger set of statistical objectives required to characterize multidimensional processes, we adopt a self-adaptive loss-balancing strategy that dynamically weights the components of the total loss function. Third, we introduce a reference-normalized validation framework that interprets statistical discrepancies relative to the finite-sample variability between independent target ensembles. We also investigate the role of the input white-noise dimension in SINN performance. We evaluate the proposed approach using a Langevin benchmark based on two coupled Duffing oscillators and further demonstrate its applicability to the Langevin dynamics of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam chain and kinetic Monte Carlo simulations of a lattice Lotka-Volterra model. Our results demonstrate that the multidimensional SINN framework provides a practical approach for modeling multidimensional stochastic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出多维统计信息神经网络（SINN）框架，用于学习和生成多分量随机过程的轨迹，并通过多个基准与应用案例验证其建模多维随机动力学的实用性。
AI.motivation: 已有SINN主要针对一维非马尔可夫过程，而实际应用需要扩展到多维过程；同时，直接估计多变量概率密度函数（PDF）会随维度增加而面临计算挑战。
AI.method: SINN基于确定性循环神经网络，以白噪声序列流为输入生成随机轨迹集合，使统计性质匹配底层随机动力学。多维扩展包括：用过程分量线性组合所构成的一维PDF集合表示联合分布信息；采用自适应损失平衡策略动态加权总损失各组成部分；引入参考归一化验证框架，以独立目标集合间的有限样本变异性为参照解释统计差异；并考察输入白噪声维度对性能的影响。
AI.result: 在基于两个耦合Duffing振子的Langevin基准上评估，并进一步应用于Fermi-Pasta-Ulam链的Langevin动力学和晶格Lotka-Volterra模型的动力学蒙特卡洛模拟；结果表明该多维SINN框架为多维随机动力学建模提供了实用方法。摘要未提供具体定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 多维SINN框架能够应对多维随机过程统计表征与计算上的挑战，并可用于多种多维随机动力学系统的建模与轨迹生成。

title: The effect of particle shape on sunlight exposure in a wind-driven free-surface flow
summary: We investigate how nonspherical marine particles, such as microplastics, phytoplankton, and ice, are exposed to sunlight near the water surface in wind-driven surface boundary layer conditions. We measure the depth and orientation of these particles in a laboratory wind-wave tank, then use this data to model how much sunlight the particles would be exposed to in an aquatic environment. In particular, we explore how their orientation affects their sunlight exposure in these conditions, since most studies to date do not account for orientation, turbulent shear flow, and wind-waves at the water surface. We find that in all cases, particles prefer certain orientations, and this causes the average sunlight exposure of the particles to be 5 to 40\% higher than would be expected if their orientations were random. Further, we find that the mean irradiance depends on the ratio of the particle mixing length $L_m$ to the light decay lengthscale $λ$, and the nature of this dependence differs between disks and rods. Disks experience disproportionately greater mean irradiance at smaller $L_m/λ$ due to the vertical variation in their orientations. These results have important implications for accurately estimating the sunlight exposure of particles in the surface boundary layer.

AI.tldr: 该研究在实验室风浪槽中测量微塑料、浮游植物和冰等非球形海洋颗粒在近水面风驱动边界层中的深度与朝向，并据此建模其阳光暴露。结果表明颗粒具有优先朝向，使其平均阳光暴露比随机朝向高5%至40%；平均辐照度还取决于混合长度与光衰减长度之比，且圆盘与杆状颗粒的依赖关系不同。
AI.motivation: 多数已有研究未同时考虑颗粒朝向、湍流剪切流和水面风浪，因而难以准确评估近水面非球形海洋颗粒受到的阳光暴露；本文旨在研究这些因素对微塑料、浮游植物和冰等颗粒光照暴露的影响。
AI.method: 在实验室风浪槽中测量非球形颗粒在风驱动表面边界层条件下的深度和朝向，并利用这些数据建模颗粒在水生环境中的阳光暴露，重点分析颗粒朝向、湍流剪切流和风浪对光照暴露的作用。
AI.result: 所有实验情况下颗粒都偏好特定朝向，导致其平均阳光暴露比随机朝向预期高5%至40%。平均辐照度取决于颗粒混合长度L_m与光衰减长度尺度λ之比，且圆盘和杆状颗粒的依赖关系不同；在较小的L_m/λ下，圆盘因朝向的垂直变化而获得不成比例更高的平均辐照度。
AI.conclusion: 颗粒朝向及风驱动表面边界层条件会显著影响非球形海洋颗粒的阳光暴露，因此准确估算表面边界层中颗粒的光照暴露需要考虑朝向、湍流剪切流和风浪；研究结果为相关估算提供了重要依据。

title: Restoring Consistency with Poynting's Theorem in Numerical MHD and RMHD
summary: For perfectly conducting plasmas, Poynting's theorem states that the time rate of change of electromagnetic energy density equals the negative of the divergence of the Poynting flux. To the best of our knowledge, this involutive theorem has never been mimetically incorporated in codes. We show that there is an inconsistency in MHD and RMHD codes that evolve face-centered magnetic fields in globally-divergence-free fashion. This is because the face-centered flux of energy density, which incorporates a Poynting vector, is evaluated using one-dimensional Riemann solvers that are applied at face-centers. However, the face-centered magnetic fields are evolved according to edge-centered electric fields that come from two-dimensional Riemann solvers that are applied to the edges of a zone. While edge-centered electric fields are used to evolve the magnetic field, they have no influence on the face-centered Poynting flux. For situations where the magnetic energy is much larger than the thermal energy, this causes a negative pressure to be evaluated at the zone-centers. This paper restores consistency by using edge-centered variables to evaluate a face-centered Poynting flux. A simple accuracy-preserving correction is made to the face-centered flux of energy density. We show that it helps considerably in simulations that have very strong magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，采用面心磁场并保持全局无散度的 MHD/RMHD 代码中，能量通量中的 Poynting 通量与磁场演化所用的边心电场不一致；作者提出用边心变量计算面心 Poynting 通量，并对能量密度面心通量作保精度修正，从而在强磁场模拟中显著改善负压问题。
AI.motivation: Poynting 定理描述电磁能量密度的时间变化率等于 Poynting 通量散度的负值，但该定理此前未被模拟式地纳入代码。作者发现，在全局无散度演化面心磁场的 MHD 和 RMHD 代码中存在不一致：面心能量密度通量包含 Poynting 矢量，却由面心的一维 Riemann 求解器计算；而面心磁场由区边缘二维 Riemann 求解器得到的边心电场演化，这些边心电场不影响面心 Poynting 通量。当磁能远大于热能时，这会导致区中心计算出负压。
AI.method: 作者通过使用边心变量来计算面心 Poynting 通量，以恢复上述一致性；并对能量密度的面心通量进行一个简单的保精度修正。
AI.result: 该修正被证明在磁场非常强的模拟中有相当大的帮助；摘要未给出具体数值结果、测试案例或定量误差指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过边心变量计算面心 Poynting 通量并修正能量密度面心通量，可以恢复 MHD/RMHD 代码中磁场演化与能量通量之间的 Poynting 定理一致性；该保精度修正显著改善强磁场情况下出现负压的问题。

title: Potential Flow, Stress, and Straightness in Flow Matching: Euler Error on Gaussian-Mixture Targets
summary: In linear flow matching, coupling straightness measures conditional displacement variance. The conditional covariance gives a kinetic stress in the Jeans balance. The virial identity relates the mean trace of the covariance to a radial moment of acceleration. Euler error also depends on how the flow propagates acceleration. On constructed Gaussian-mixture targets, closed-form couplings with matched straightness yield different median Euler errors. Learned fields from fresh minibatch assignments also yield different Euler errors from their partners at matched estimated straightness. The leading Euler coefficient accounts for more of the error variation than straightness in these experiments. We relate the additive-noise characterization of isotropic Gaussian sources to potential flow. A gradient constraint reduces velocity error on the independent isotropic Gaussian example and increases it on two examples with rotational exact fields.

AI.tldr: 该文分析线性流匹配中耦合直线度与Euler离散误差的关系：将条件协方差视为Jeans平衡中的动理学应力，并用virial恒等式联系其平均迹与加速度径向矩；在高斯混合目标上，即使直线度匹配，不同闭式耦合或学习场的Euler误差仍不同，且主导Euler系数比直线度解释更多误差变化；最后讨论各向同性高斯源加噪与势流的关系及梯度约束对速度误差的影响。
AI.motivation: 摘要未直接说明研究动机；其关注点是直线度是否足以预测Euler误差，以及条件协方差、加速度传播和主导Euler项如何影响误差差异，并考察各向同性高斯源与梯度约束的作用。
AI.method: 在线性流匹配框架下，将耦合直线度定义为条件位移方差，把条件协方差解释为Jeans平衡中的动理学应力，利用virial恒等式将协方差的平均迹与加速度径向矩联系起来；分析Euler误差对加速度传播方式的依赖；在构造的高斯混合目标上，比较具有匹配直线度的闭式耦合以及来自新小批量分配的学习场所产生的Euler误差；并研究各向同性高斯源的可加噪声刻画与势流的关系及梯度约束实验。
AI.result: 在构造的高斯混合目标上，具有匹配直线度的不同闭式耦合给出不同的中位Euler误差；来自新小批量分配的学习场与其配对场在估计直线度匹配时也给出不同Euler误差；这些实验中，主导Euler系数比直线度解释更多误差变化。梯度约束在独立各向同性高斯例子中降低速度误差，但在两个具有旋转精确场的例子中提高速度误差。
AI.conclusion: 直线度不足以完全决定Euler误差；条件协方差、加速度传播及主导Euler项对误差差异具有重要作用。梯度约束的效果在所述例子中方向不一致，在两个旋转精确场例子中反而增大速度误差。摘要未提供更一般的理论或实证结论。

title: Verifying the High-Energy Tail in Bi-Kappa Particle Loading: Three-Dimensional Tests, Velocity Bounds, and Finite Precision
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in APS Open Science (Data/Code). Code: https://github.com/KehengZhu/bi-kappa-distribution-sampling
summary: The bi-Kappa distribution models anisotropic space-plasma populations with suprathermal power-law tails. Kinetic simulations represent such a population by computational particles, and a loader draws their velocities from the requested bi-Kappa distribution, which we call the target distribution. When $κ$ is close to 1/2, floating-point underflow can remove the largest draws, and a velocity bound changes the loaded distribution. Published Kappa loaders are usually verified by comparing histograms of the speed or of one velocity component with the analytic distribution. Such comparisons do not examine the direction of the velocity or whether the direction is independent of the speed. We build an anisotropic loader on an established Gamma-ratio construction and examine each of these problems. Near $κ=1/2$, evaluating the Gamma ratio on a logarithmic scale avoids the loss of draws to underflow in single and double precision down to $κ=0.5001$. When draws outside a bound on each velocity component are discarded and redrawn, a small rejected fraction can accompany a large change in the tail. At $κ=2$ and $θ_\parallel=2θ_\perp$, a bound at 20 times each component's thermal speed rejects a fraction $3.6\times10^{-4}$ of the draws and lowers the 99.9th-percentile speed by 11%. We test the loaded velocities through their direction and their normalized radius, the length of the velocity after each component is divided by $\sqrtκ$ times its thermal speed. The tests used nine values of $κ$ from 0.51 to 10, including $1/2<κ\le3/2$, where the second moments do not exist, with $θ_\parallel=2θ_\perp$ in double precision. At every $κ$, $χ^2$ tests find the normalized radius out to its 99.999th percentile, the direction, and their joint distribution consistent with the target distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并检验一种基于Gamma比值构造的各向异性bi-Kappa速度加载器，重点解决低κ下浮点下溢、速度分量截断导致的尾部偏差，以及传统直方图检验未覆盖方向与速率-方向联合分布的问题。
AI.motivation: bi-Kappa分布用于描述具有超热幂律尾的各向异性空间等离子体，但现有加载器在κ接近1/2时可能因浮点下溢丢失最大抽样值，速度边界也会改变实际加载分布；已有验证通常只比较速率或单个速度分量的直方图，未检查速度方向及其与速率的独立性。
AI.method: 在既有Gamma比值构造上实现各向异性加载器；在κ接近1/2时采用对数尺度计算Gamma比值；分析对每个速度分量施加边界并拒绝重抽所造成的影响；通过归一化半径（各分量除以sqrt(κ)乘热速度后的速度长度）、速度方向及其联合分布进行χ²检验，测试κ=0.51至10共9个值，包括1/2<κ≤3/2且二阶矩不存在的区间，并采用θ_parallel=2θ_perp和双精度。
AI.result: 对数尺度计算在单精度和双精度下均可在低至κ=0.5001时避免下溢导致的抽样丢失；在κ=2、θ_parallel=2θ_perp时，将每个分量限制在20倍热速度会拒绝3.6×10^-4的抽样，却使99.9百分位速率降低11%；在所有测试κ值上，χ²检验表明归一化半径至其99.999百分位、速度方向及二者联合分布均与目标分布一致。
AI.conclusion: 对数尺度Gamma比值可稳健处理接近κ=1/2的加载；即使分量截断的拒绝比例很小，也可能显著改变高能尾部，因此需关注边界偏差；基于归一化半径、方向和联合分布的检验能够验证完整速度分布，包括方向及速率-方向关系，并覆盖二阶矩不存在的低κ情形。

title: Active flow control based on topological data analysis and a DMDc reduced-order model for drag reduction
summary: Controlling and reducing undesirable vortical structures in unsteady flows is a major issue in aerodynamics. This paper presents an active control methodology that combines topological data analysis (TDA) through persistence diagrams, a reduced-order model based on dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc) and receding-horizon model predictive control (MPC). Vortices are detected and characterised by the persistence diagram of the absolute value of the vorticity, which makes it possible to define a target flow in which only the useful vortices are retained. This target flow is computed offline in the reduced space by gradient descent, the derivative of a persistence diagram being defined through a parametrisation of the space of diagrams. The control loop then reduces to a small-dimensional convex quadratic program, whose construction we detail and whose cost we compare with that of an approach that places the diagrams directly in the cost function. The approach is applied numerically to the flow around an oscillating aircraft wing for seven vibration frequencies, and yields a mean reduction of the drag coefficient while preserving the main vortices.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种主动控制方法，结合持久图拓扑数据分析、基于带控制动态模态分解（DMDc）的降阶模型和滚动时域模型预测控制（MPC）；通过绝对涡量的持久图识别涡结构并构造仅保留有用涡的目标流，在降阶空间中离线用梯度下降计算目标流，在线控制转化为小维度凸二次规划；在振荡机翼绕流七个振动频率下数值验证，平均阻力系数降低且主要涡保留。
AI.motivation: 控制和减少非定常流动中的不利涡结构是空气动力学中的重要问题，论文旨在提供一种能够主动调控涡结构并降低阻力的控制方法。
AI.method: 方法将拓扑数据分析中的持久图、基于DMDc的降阶模型与滚动时域MPC结合。以绝对涡量的持久图检测和表征涡，定义仅保留有用涡的目标流；目标流在降阶空间中离线通过梯度下降计算，并借助图空间参数化定义持久图的导数。控制回路简化为小维度凸二次规划，论文详细给出其构造，并与将持久图直接置于代价函数中的方法比较计算成本。
AI.result: 方法被数值应用于振荡飞机机翼绕流，覆盖七个振动频率；结果显示平均阻力系数降低，同时主要涡得到保留。摘要未提供具体阻力降低数值或各频率的定量结果。

title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
summary: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We find that the pretrained models fail to accurately capture Na-Na and Na-C interactions for metallic Na clusters on graphene. To recover a DFT-level energetic description, we employ targeted fine-tuning, showing that it can describe the energetic stability of local motifs and achieve sufficient transferability to unseen Na/C environments. With the developed fine-tuned model, we establish a correlation between closed-pore radius in hard carbon and plateau voltage, showing that the small pores contribute at larger voltages than large ones, suggesting thus how the developed fine-tuned foundation model can link atomistic information with materials design for complex bonding environments.

AI.tldr: 该文评估基于MACE架构的预训练原子基础模型在硬碳中不同局部Na/C结构基元上的可靠性，发现预训练模型难以准确描述石墨烯上金属Na团簇的Na-Na与Na-C相互作用；通过定向微调可恢复DFT级能量描述并迁移到未见Na/C环境，进而建立闭孔半径与平台电压的关联。
AI.motivation: 原子基础模型有望在复杂化学环境中达到DFT级材料模拟精度，但其在竞争性成键体系中的可靠性以及复杂成键如何影响材料性质预测仍不清晰；硬碳储钠正涉及缺陷/弯曲石墨区、无定形区及闭孔/开孔等多种局部结构基元，对Na离子电池具有重要意义。
AI.method: 系统评估现有基于MACE架构的预训练基础模型在不同局部Na/C基元上的表现，并采用针对性微调以恢复DFT级能量描述、检验其对未见Na/C环境的迁移能力；随后用微调模型分析硬碳闭孔半径与平台电压的关系。
AI.result: 预训练模型无法准确捕捉石墨烯上金属Na团簇的Na-Na和Na-C相互作用；定向微调能够描述局部基元的能量稳定性，并具有对未见Na/C环境的足够迁移性。微调模型显示硬碳闭孔半径与平台电压相关，小孔较大孔在更高电压下贡献。摘要未提供具体误差数值或定量性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 针对性微调可将原子基础模型用于复杂成键环境下的局部能量描述，并连接原子尺度信息与材料设计；闭孔尺寸与电压的关联为硬碳储钠机理理解和材料优化提供了依据。

title: Compressible gas flow through porous media under forced pressure and fluxes: compressibility number and pressure curvature
comment: 55 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Fluid Mechanics
summary: Gas compressibility induces a nonlinear relationship between boundary forcing and pressure evolution in porous media. This matters in operations and experiments where inlet pressure, volumetric flux or mass flux is controlled, as each forcing produces a distinct transient approach to steady state. We analyze this systematically for isothermal gas flow, using the porous medium equation (PME), nondimensionalized in terms of a Peclet-type number $Π$ that compares the time scales of gas flow and pressure diffusion and measures the steady flow compression. At steady state, increasing $Π$ leads to a boundary layer near the outlet, of width $\simΠ^{-1}$, where the velocity and flow expansion scale as $Π$ and $Π^2$, respectively. Since $Π$ fixes the steady compression for all three inlet conditions, their transients can be compared directly. We derive a semi-analytical perturbation series in $β=2Π/(1+2Π)<1$, valid for the three inlet conditions, which remains convergent at large $Π$. Numerical solutions for $10^{-2}\leqΠ\leq10^3$ show that the effective pressure-squared diffusivity plateaus at boundary-condition-dependent values for $Π\ll1$, and scales as $Π^{1/2}$ for $Π\gg1$, explained by the slowest eigenmode of the linearized PME about its steady state. To resolve local flow compression, we introduce the pressure curvature, $κ=\nabla^2 p$, and interpret its evolution through a nonlinear advection-diffusion-reaction equation. Curvature fields reveal localized compression pulses that migrate downstream and dissipate as the system relaxes, while curvature moments highlight a $Π$-dependent crossover from compression- to expansion-dominated transients. Applications to gas chromatography and underground hydrogen storage are illustrated.

AI.tldr: 本文基于多孔介质方程系统分析等温气体在多孔介质中的瞬态与稳态流动，引入Peclet型无量纲数Π统一比较入口压力、体积通量和质量通量三种控制方式；结合稳态边界层分析、以β=2Π/(1+2Π)展开的半解析微扰级数、数值解及压力曲率诊断，揭示稳态压缩、有效压力平方扩散率和压缩/膨胀瞬态随Π的变化，并说明在气相色谱与地下储氢中的应用。
AI.motivation: 气体可压缩性使边界强迫与压力演化呈非线性关系；在入口压力、体积通量或质量通量受控的作业与实验中，不同强迫方式会导致不同的瞬态趋稳过程，因而需要系统比较并统一刻画这些过程，同时理解稳态流动压缩及其对瞬态的影响。
AI.method: 采用多孔介质方程描述等温气体流动，并以比较气体流动与压力扩散时间尺度、度量稳态流动压缩的Peclet型数Π进行无量纲化；分析稳态出口边界层，推导对三种入口条件均适用、且在β=2Π/(1+2Π)<1下收敛的半解析微扰级数；对10^-2≤Π≤10^3进行数值求解，并用线性化多孔介质方程围绕稳态的最慢本征模态解释有效压力平方扩散率；引入压力曲率κ=∇²p，将其演化解释为非线性对流-扩散-反应方程，并利用曲率场与曲率矩分析局部压缩。
AI.result: 稳态下，增大Π会在出口附近形成宽度约1/Π的边界层，其中速度与流动膨胀分别按Π和Π²尺度变化；Π固定了三种入口条件下的稳态压缩，使瞬态可直接比较。数值结果表明，有效压力平方扩散率在Π≪1时趋于依赖边界条件的平台值，在Π≫1时按Π^{1/2}尺度变化，并由最慢本征模态解释。曲率场显示局部压缩脉冲向下游迁移并在系统松弛中耗散，曲率矩揭示随Π变化的由压缩主导到膨胀主导的瞬态交叉。
AI.conclusion: Π是统一控制稳态压缩和瞬态趋稳行为的关键无量纲参数；所推导的微扰级数适用于三种入口条件并在大Π下保持收敛；出口边界层、有效扩散率标度及曲率脉冲/矩分析共同刻画了可压缩气体流动的瞬态压缩特征，并可用于气相色谱和地下储氢等场景。摘要仅说明展示了这些应用，未提供具体实验验证或现场数据。

title: Graph diffusion transformer for interpretable generation and inverse design of disordered atomic structures
summary: Atomic disorder offers a potent degree of freedom to tailor material properties, yet the resulting vast configuration space obscures structure-property relations and hinders rational inverse design. Here we introduce Graph Amorphous Diffusion Transformer (GaDiT), a generative model that combines dynamic periodic graphs, masked conditioning and an interval-weighted training-noise distribution. GaDiT generates high-quality disordered structures while accelerating sampling by two orders of magnitude compared with existing corrector-based approaches, as demonstrated across two-dimensional amorphous carbon and three-dimensional amorphous silicon and silica. Moreover, GaDiT supports conditional generation under single or combined structural features, physical properties and preparation conditions in a unified model, and enables inverse design that expands accessible structure-property ranges beyond the training distribution. To interpret these structures and the trained network, we propose a conditioned atomic response mapping analysis, revealing both the global structural descriptors and the local atomic environments that govern target properties. Overall, GaDiT establishes a general framework for interpretable generation, inverse design and structure-property discovery for disordered atomic structures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出生成模型GaDiT，用于无序原子结构的可解释生成、逆设计与结构—性质发现，并在二维非晶碳及三维非晶硅、二氧化硅上验证。
AI.motivation: 原子无序为调控材料性质提供了强大自由度，但巨大的构型空间使结构—性质关系难以厘清，也阻碍了理性的逆向设计。
AI.method: 提出Graph Amorphous Diffusion Transformer（GaDiT），将动态周期图、掩码条件化和区间加权训练噪声分布结合；模型支持在统一框架下按单一或组合的结构特征、物理性质与制备条件进行条件生成，并采用条件原子响应映射分析解释生成结构及训练网络。
AI.result: GaDiT可生成高质量无序结构，采样速度较现有基于校正器的方法快两个数量级；在二维非晶碳和三维非晶硅、二氧化硅上得到验证；支持多类条件生成与逆向设计，并可扩展超出训练分布的结构—性质范围；条件原子响应映射分析揭示了主导目标性质的全局结构描述符和局部原子环境。摘要未提供具体定量性能指标、数据集规模及采样耗时数值。
AI.conclusion: GaDiT为无序原子结构的可解释生成、逆向设计及结构—性质发现建立了通用框架。

title: Flow structure, heat transport, and dissipation in vertical-field magnetoconvection at similar Reynolds numbers
summary: We employ direct numerical simulations to investigate the effect of a vertical magnetic field on the flow structures, heat transport, and dissipation rates in Rayleigh--Bénard convection of a low-Prandtl-number fluid ($\mathrm{Pr} = 0.025$) at an approximately fixed Reynolds number ($\mathrm{Re} \approx 880$), maintained by adjusting the Rayleigh number to compensate for the Lorentz force. As the Hartmann number increases, the flow becomes more anisotropic, which strengthens the positive convective heat fluxes relative to the negative ones and thereby raises the Nusselt number, accompanied by a thinning of the thermal boundary layers. The total viscous and thermal dissipation rates are dominated by the boundary layers, whereas the total magnetic dissipation rate is dominated by the bulk. With increasing Hartmann number, the boundary-layer fraction of the viscous and magnetic dissipation rates increases, whereas that of the thermal dissipation computed from the temperature fluctuations decreases, owing to the suppression of temperature fluctuations near the boundary layers. The dissipation rates deviate from log-normality and are well described by stretched exponential distributions, whose tails become more extended with increasing Hartmann number.

AI.tldr: 该文通过直接数值模拟研究竖直磁场对低普朗特数（Pr=0.025）瑞利-贝纳德对流的影响，在约固定雷诺数（Re≈880）下调节瑞利数以补偿洛伦兹力，分析流场结构、热输运和耗散率随哈特曼数的变化。
AI.motivation: 在低普朗特数、近似固定雷诺数条件下，考察竖直磁场如何改变瑞利-贝纳德对流的流场结构、热输运与黏性、热及磁耗散率，并弥补以往对这些效应认识不足。
AI.method: 采用直接数值模拟，工质为Pr=0.025的低普朗特数流体，保持Re≈880，通过调整瑞利数以补偿洛伦兹力，并改变哈特曼数进行参数研究。
AI.result: 随哈特曼数增大，流动各向异性增强，正向对流传热通量相对负向通量增强，使努塞尔数升高，同时热边界层变薄；总黏性与热耗散率由边界层主导，总磁耗散率由体区主导；随哈特曼数增大，黏性和磁耗散的边界层占比增加，而由温度脉动计算的热耗散边界层占比下降，原因是边界层附近温度脉动受到抑制；耗散率偏离对数正态分布，可由拉伸指数分布较好描述，且随哈特曼数增大分布尾部更展宽。
AI.conclusion: 竖直磁场在固定Re附近通过增强流动各向异性提高努塞尔数并改变边界层与体区的耗散分配；耗散率统计呈现非对数正态的拉伸指数分布，且磁场增强使分布尾部更展宽。

title: Reconciling global and local spin models
summary: Magnetic interactions based on first-principles calculations can be casted either into global spin models, where the interactions are configuration-independent, or into local spin models, where the effective parameters depend explicitly on the underlying spin configuration. Although these two perspectives often yield seemingly inconsistent results, we demonstrate that they can be reconciled by restricting the analysis to transverse spin fluctuations. We develop a projection scheme that systematically removes spurious longitudinal contributions from local interaction matrices, thereby establishing a rigorous connection between the projected local interactions and the underlying global multispin Hamiltonian. Applying our approach to the prototype systems (i) a Cr trimer on Au(111) (ii) Fe and Cr dimers on Cu(001), we show that the projected local interaction parameters quantitatively reproduce those obtained from the global four-spin model. This work provides a unified framework to interpret local and global spin models on equal footing and resolves long-standing ambiguities in the identification of effective interactions such as the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in a non-collinear framework.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种投影方案：仅考虑横向自旋涨落，并剔除局域相互作用矩阵中的虚假纵向贡献，从而把局域自旋模型与全局多自旋哈密顿量严格关联。在Cr三聚体/Au(111)以及Fe、Cr二聚体/Cu(001)上的验证表明，投影后的局域参数可定量复现全局四自旋模型的结果，统一了两类模型，并澄清了非共线体系中DMI等有效相互作用识别的歧义。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理磁相互作用既可表述为构型无关的全局自旋模型，也可表述为有效参数显式依赖自旋构型的局域自旋模型；这两种视角常给出看似不一致的结果。作者旨在调和二者，并消除非共线框架下DMI等有效相互作用识别中的长期歧义。
AI.method: 将分析限制在横向自旋涨落，发展投影方案，系统移除局域相互作用矩阵中的虚假纵向贡献，从而建立投影后的局域相互作用与底层全局多自旋哈密顿量之间的严格联系；并在Cr三聚体/Au(111)、Fe和Cr二聚体/Cu(001)原型体系上应用和检验该方案。
AI.result: 投影得到的局域相互作用参数定量复现了全局四自旋模型获得的参数；摘要未提供具体数值或误差指标。所列原型体系的结果支持局域与全局描述在横向自旋涨落框架下的相容性。
AI.conclusion: 作者提供了一个统一框架，使局域与全局自旋模型可在同等基础上解释，并解决非共线体系中DMI等有效相互作用识别的歧义；具体适用边界和数值精度未在摘要中给出。

title: Near-wall sedimentation of short cylinders at low Reynolds numbers: Translational and angular velocity models and experimental validation
summary: The sedimentation of short cylinders near rigid walls involves coupled translational and rotational motion, for which readily applicable kinematic descriptions remain limited. In this study, theoretical expressions for the translational and angular velocities were derived by combining slender-body theory, semi-empirical finite-aspect-ratio corrections, and hydrodynamic descriptions of fluid inertia and wall effects. The resulting expressions were assessed through time-resolved sedimentation experiments with rigid cylinders of mean aspect ratios $\barχ\approx3.8$--$5.8$ in a rectangular duct at particle Reynolds numbers of $Re_{\mathrm P}\approx O(10^{-1})$. The experiments revealed distinct near-wall trajectories, including non-contact glancing motion and contact-induced flipping. For glancing trajectories, the predicted translational and angular velocities reproduced the principal features of the measured kinematics, with good qualitative and, over substantial parts of the trajectories, quantitative agreement. The comparisons also identified different ranges of applicability for the investigated wall corrections and showed that wall-induced effects dominated the angular velocity under the conditions studied. The resulting, experimentally validated expressions provide readily applicable estimates of the instantaneous translational and angular velocities of short cylinders near rigid walls and a reference for investigating additional influences on their sedimentation dynamics, including lower Reynolds numbers and particle or wall elasticity.

AI.tldr: 该文针对短圆柱在刚性壁面附近沉降时平移与转动耦合、现有运动学描述有限的问题，结合细长体理论、有限长径比半经验修正及流体惯性与壁面效应的流体力学描述，推导平移和角速度表达式，并用长径比约3.8–5.8的刚性圆柱在矩形管道、粒子雷诺数O(10^-1)下的时间分辨沉降实验进行验证；结果捕捉了非接触掠射和接触诱导翻转等近壁轨迹，并表明在所研究条件下壁致效应对角速度占主导。
AI.motivation: 短圆柱在刚性壁附近的沉降涉及平移与旋转的耦合运动，但可直接应用的瞬时运动学描述仍然有限，因此需要建立并实验验证可估算平移速度和角速度的表达式。
AI.method: 将细长体理论、有限长径比的半经验修正以及流体惯性和壁面效应的流体力学描述相结合，推导短圆柱平移速度和角速度的理论表达式；随后采用平均长径比约为3.8–5.8的刚性圆柱，在矩形管道中于粒子雷诺数约为O(10^-1)的条件下开展时间分辨沉降实验，并将预测结果与实测运动学进行比较。
AI.result: 实验观察到不同的近壁轨迹，包括非接触掠射运动和接触诱导翻转。对于掠射轨迹，预测的平移速度和角速度再现了实测运动学的主要特征，具有良好定性一致性，并在轨迹的较大部分上具有定量一致性。比较还识别了所考察壁面修正的不同适用范围，并表明在所研究条件下壁致效应主导角速度。摘要未提供具体误差指标、表达式形式及接触翻转的定量预测细节。
AI.conclusion: 所得并经实验验证的表达式可用于快速估算短圆柱在刚性壁附近的瞬时平移速度和角速度，并为研究更低雷诺数以及颗粒或壁面弹性等附加因素对其沉降动力学的影响提供参考。摘要未说明这些表达式对接触诱导翻转轨迹的适用性。

title: Tunable Hybridization of Whispering Gallery Modes in High-Index Photonic Molecules
summary: Photonic molecules formed by coupled dielectric microresonators provide a platform for controlling collective optical modes, yet the interplay between molecular topology, resonator detuning, and dielectric environment in determining their spectral response remains insufficiently quantified. Here, we systematically quantify the evolution of Whispering Gallery Mode (WGM) hybridization in high-index TiO$_2$ and perovskite coated TiO$_2$ microresonators with molecular topology, and establish the corresponding effective inter-cavity coupling using a combined numerical and analytical analysis. We further show that perovskite-shell incorporation provides a diameter and thickness-dependent modification of the effective coupling, producing a non-monotonic response rather than a uniform suppression of coupling. Despite the resulting closely spaced hybridized resonances in the high-index perovskite environment, the supermodes remain spectrally resolvable, with $Q$-factor of order \(10^3\) for representative modes. The observed spectral splitting is quantitatively related to the effective inter-cavity coupling strengths, revealing a non-monotonic coupling response to perovskite-shell incorporation that depends on resonator size and shell thickness. These results establish molecular topology and dielectric environment as distinct parameters for controlling WGM hybridization, inter-cavity coupling, and spectral response, providing a basis for the design of coupled resonator systems for applications in optical sensing, filtering, switching, and other resonant photonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高折射率TiO2及钙钛矿包覆TiO2微谐振腔中回音壁模式杂化随分子拓扑的演化，并用数值与解析结合的方法提取有效腔间耦合；结果表明钙钛矿壳层会随直径和厚度非单调地调控耦合，杂化超模仍可分辨且代表性Q因子约为10^3。
AI.motivation: 光子系统中的分子拓扑、谐振腔失谐与介电环境如何共同决定光谱响应仍缺乏充分量化，本文旨在填补这一空白并建立拓扑与介电环境对回音壁模式杂化和腔间耦合的独立调控作用。
AI.method: 制备/研究高折射率TiO2微谐振腔及钙钛矿包覆TiO2微谐振腔，系统量化回音壁模式杂化随分子拓扑的演化；采用数值与解析相结合的分析建立有效腔间耦合，并考察钙钛矿壳层引起的直径和厚度依赖耦合修正。摘要未提供具体拓扑构型、尺寸与壳层厚度数值及耦合强度数值。
AI.result: 钙钛矿壳层对有效耦合的修改随谐振腔直径和壳层厚度变化，表现为非单调响应而非均匀抑制；尽管在高折射率钙钛矿环境中杂化共振间距较近，超模仍具光谱可分辨性，代表性模式Q因子约为10^3；光谱分裂与有效腔间耦合强度定量相关，并呈现依赖尺寸和壳层厚度的非单调耦合响应。
AI.conclusion: 分子拓扑与介电环境可作为调控回音壁模式杂化、腔间耦合和光谱响应的两个独立参数，为光学传感、滤波、开关及其他共振光子器件中的耦合谐振腔系统设计提供依据。

title: Spin-adapted sample-based quantum diagonalization with randomized time evolution
summary: Quantum algorithms based on the classical post-processing of measurement samples have emerged as effective and robust methods to approximate low-energy wavefunctions of many-body quantum systems on present-day and early-fault-tolerant quantum devices. This paper introduces a generic framework for enforcing spin symmetry within these approaches. We tailor this framework to SqDRIFT, a sample-based quantum diagonalization variant that uses the qDRIFT randomized compilation protocol to generate the quantum samples. We discuss how three key components of SqDRIFT (the initial-state preparation, the construction of the time-evolution circuits, and the classical post-processing) can be adapted to incorporate spin symmetry. We show that spin-pure circuits alone are not sufficient, since the sampled determinants generally span a subspace that is not closed under $\hat{S}^2$, and we restore this closure by completing the sampled electronic configurations. In classical simulations of 4-aminobenzonitrile and of an $[\text{Fe}(\text{NH}_{3})_{4}]^{2+}$ model complex, and in experiments on an IBM quantum processor for the oxo-Mn(Salen) complex, this spin-adapted post-processing yields roots that are exact spin eigenfunctions at every subspace size. On hardware, it does so with diagonalized subspaces two to three orders of magnitude smaller than those of the conventional constructions for the same circuit depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在基于测量样本经典后处理的量子多体波函数近似方法中强制自旋对称性的通用框架，并将其用于SqDRIFT，从而以更小对角化子空间获得精确自旋本征态。
AI.motivation: 基于测量样本经典后处理的量子算法是在当前及早期容错量子设备上近似多体量子系统低能波函数的有效且稳健的方法，本文旨在为此类方法引入自旋对称性约束。
AI.method: 提出强制自旋对称性的通用框架，并针对使用qDRIFT随机编译生成量子样本的SqDRIFT进行定制，分别调整初态制备、时间演化电路构建和经典后处理；指出仅使用自旋纯电路不足，因为采样行列式张成的子空间通常对$\hat{S}^2$不封闭，并通过补全采样电子组态恢复封闭性。
AI.result: 在4-氨基苯甲腈和[$\text{Fe}(\text{NH}_{3})_{4}]^{2+}$模型复体的经典模拟以及IBM量子处理器上oxo-Mn(Salen)复体的实验中，该自旋适配后处理在每个子空间尺寸下均给出精确自旋本征函数根；在硬件上，相同电路深度下所需对角化子空间比传统构造小两到三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将自旋对称性系统性地纳入SqDRIFT的初态、演化电路和经典后处理，可在保持精确自旋本征性的同时显著降低硬件所需对角化子空间规模。

title: Sign-switchable and tunable macroscopic curvature of liquid jets by microscopic laser-induced cavitation
summary: Localized forcing of liquid jets can trigger Rayleigh-Plateau breakup at low perturbation amplitudes or explosive fragmentation at high amplitudes, while controlled bending in the intermediate regime has remained unexplored. We show that femtosecond-laser-induced cavitation, seeded at the interface of a 100 micrometre-diameter water jet, produces a selectable curvature in 0.4-1 mm long segments. Cavitation rupturing at the liquid-air interface drives fast outward jetting and induces a slower recoil on the opposite boundary, which evolves on the capillary-inertial timescale and results in curving of the liquid segment. The curvature is governed by three laser parameters. Off-axis laser illumination on the jet shifts the refractive caustics and redistributes energy deposition between the front and rear interfaces. The resulting recoil imbalance determines the curvature sign, with a straight configuration in the balanced case. Laser energy offers additional control over the recoil impulse via plasma defocusing and nonlinear absorption in the liquid jet, where the response is bounded by axisymmetric deformation at low energy and explosive vaporization at high energy. Repetition rate sets the spacing between successive cavitation events and hence the length of the bent segment. Curvature extends across the segment for lengths of 6-10 jet diameters; shorter segments undergo Rayleigh-Plateau breakup, whereas longer ones bend mainly near their retracting ends. Our results offer a platform for optofluidic control of switchable and tunable macroscopic curvature in flowing liquid jets.

AI.tldr: 该文利用飞秒激光在百微米水射流界面诱发空化，通过离轴照射、激光能量和重复频率三个参数，在0.4–1 mm液段中实现可选曲率，并界定弯曲、Rayleigh–Plateau破碎与爆炸性蒸发的参数区间，为流动态液体射流的可切换、可调宏观弯曲提供光流控平台。
AI.motivation: 局部作用于液体射流可引发低扰动下的Rayleigh–Plateau破碎或高扰动下的爆炸性碎裂，但中间区域的可控弯曲尚未被探索；作者希望填补这一空白，并实现流动液体射流中可切换、可调的宏观曲率。
AI.method: 在直径100微米的水射流界面处，用飞秒激光诱导空化，使0.4–1 mm长液段产生可选弯曲。界面空化破裂驱动快速向外喷射，并在对侧边界引发较慢的反冲，该反冲按毛细—惯性时间尺度演化并导致液段弯曲。研究调节三个激光参数：离轴照明改变折射焦散及前后界面能量沉积，从而决定反冲失衡与曲率符号；激光能量通过等离子体散焦和非线性吸收控制反冲冲量；重复频率决定连续空化事件间距及弯曲段长度。
AI.result: 可实现可选曲率，平衡照射时为直射流构型。离轴照射造成前后界面能量沉积重分布和反冲失衡，从而决定曲率符号。能量响应受低能量轴对称变形和高能量爆炸性蒸发的边界限制。重复频率设定弯曲段长度。曲率可覆盖6–10个射流直径的长度；更短液段发生Rayleigh–Plateau破碎，更长液段主要在回缩端附近弯曲。
AI.conclusion: 飞秒激光诱导的界面空化可在流动液体射流中产生可切换、可调的宏观弯曲，为光流控操纵液体射流提供平台；摘要未提供定量曲率范围、效率或长期稳定性等细节。

title: Enhanced Hyperspectral Nano-FTIR Imaging by Neural-Network-Based Processing of Multiple Signal Harmonics
summary: Nano-FTIR spectroscopy combines infrared spectroscopy with nanometer-scale spatial resolution and enables hyperspectral nanoimaging. However, quantitative measurements typically rely on higher-harmonic near-field signals, which are largely background-free but suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Lower harmonics provide substantially higher SNR but contain significant background contributions that distort the near-field response and hinder quantitative analysis. Here, we introduce a cross-harmonic neural network (CHNN) that exploits the complementary information encoded in multiple harmonic channels to denoise third-harmonic hyperspectral data. Trained directly on experimental nano-FTIR datasets, the CHNN uses first- and second-harmonic spectra to improve the SNR of the third-harmonic response. Applied to a PMMA/PS polymer blend, it substantially reduces noise while preserving spectral features and nanoscale spatial contrast. Compared with conventional single-harmonic denoising using an autoencoder, the CHNN achieves superior noise suppression. These results demonstrate the potential of lower-harmonic signals for improving hyperspectral nano-FTIR imaging without increasing acquisition time.

AI.tldr: 提出跨谐波神经网络（CHNN），利用第一、第二谐波光谱对三次谐波高光谱nano-FTIR数据进行去噪；在PMMA/PS共混物上显著降噪并保留光谱特征与纳米尺度空间对比，性能优于单谐波自编码器方法。
AI.motivation: nano-FTIR可实现纳米尺度空间分辨的红外光谱与高光谱纳米成像，但定量测量通常依赖高次谐波近场信号：其背景几乎可忽略，却信噪比低；低次谐波信噪比更高，却含显著背景，扭曲近场响应并妨碍定量分析。
AI.method: 构建跨谐波神经网络（CHNN），利用多个谐波通道中的互补信息对三次谐波高光谱数据去噪；网络直接基于实验nano-FTIR数据集训练，并以第一、第二谐波光谱提升第三谐波响应的信噪比。摘要未提供网络结构、训练参数及数据集规模等细节。
AI.result: 将CHNN应用于PMMA/PS聚合物共混物后，噪声显著降低，同时保留光谱特征和纳米尺度空间对比；与传统基于自编码器的单谐波去噪相比，CHNN的噪声抑制更优。摘要未给出具体信噪比提升或定量误差数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，低次谐波信号可用于改善高光谱nano-FTIR成像，且无需增加采集时间。

title: A Machine-learning-aided Workflow for Sampling Small Polaron Dynamics in Energy Materials
summary:
One of the defining characteristics of most energy materials, used as e.g.~battery electrodes, photovoltaics, or photocatalysts, is their ability conduct charges such as electrons and holes. The exact mechanism of this conductivity depends on the material, but is often dominated by the existence of mobile small polarons, i.e.~electrons or holes strongly localised through the polarisation of their environment. Computationally, small polarons can be treated with reasonably accuracy through the use of self-interaction corrected or hybrid density functional theory (DFT) together with local geometry optimisation. Similar approaches can be employed to determine the energy barriers to movement of the polarons through hopping. Unfortunately, realistic energy materials tend have very large numbers of symmetry inequivalent polaronic configurations and correspondingly large numbers of hopping barriers, making them hard to tackle explicitly.
  In this work we therefore extend the computational reach of DFT calculations with machine-learned (ML) surrogate models, which then feed into a kinetic model to quantitatively estimate the conductivity of a battery anode material (Li$_4$Ti$_5$O$_12$ or LTO) at realistic, defected conditions. We calculate the conductivity at room temperature to be 6.7 $\times$ 10$^{-3}$ S/cm which lies well in the experimental range. To this end, we only needed a total of 154 polaron barrier calculations, out of 3649 symmetry inequivalent ones, achieving an over 20-fold increase of computational efficiency. Overall, our work demonstrates how DFT-trained ML surrogates can be used to quantitatively and efficiently sample the dynamics of small polarons in energy materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作将DFT计算与机器学习代理模型及动力学模型结合，用少量极化子跳跃势垒计算定量估算缺陷条件下Li4Ti5O12负极的室温电导率，并显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 许多能源材料（如电池电极、光伏和光催化材料）的导电性由移动小极化子主导；用自相互作用校正或杂化DFT加局部几何优化可较准确处理小极化子及跳跃势垒，但真实材料中对称不等价极化子构型和跳跃势垒数量巨大，难以逐一显式计算。
AI.method: 作者用DFT训练机器学习代理模型，并将其接入动力学模型，以在真实缺陷条件下定量估算电池负极材料Li4Ti5O12（LTO）的电导率；小极化子及跳跃势垒基于自相互作用校正或杂化DFT与局部几何优化处理。摘要未说明具体机器学习模型类型。
AI.result: 在3649个对称不等价极化子势垒计算中仅需计算154个，计算效率提高20倍以上；估算得到LTO室温电导率为6.7×10^-3 S/cm，处于实验范围内。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，经DFT训练的机器学习代理模型可用于定量且高效地采样能源材料中小极化子的动力学行为，并扩展DFT计算的可处理规模。

title: Global saddle selection and exact absolute-instability boundaries for convection in porous media with throughflow
summary: In the Darcy-Prats problem, horizontal throughflow leaves the temporal onset of convection unchanged but raises the heating required for a localized disturbance to grow at a fixed point. The saddle equations give five candidates, but only the saddles reached by deformation of the Fourier contour contribute to the growth. For $Ra>π^2$, $Pe>0$ we prove that the same off-axis pair contributes throughout the domain: no Stokes transition can change its contribution. Its growth gives a unique analytic absolute threshold, first reached by the lowest vertical mode. Rescaling transfers the selection to Forchheimer drag, transverse rolls of a power-law fluid, anisotropic permeability, an open upper boundary and a vertical magnetic field. A shift of the same growth function accounts for interphase heat exchange in a model of metallic foam. At prescribed throughflow the threshold increases strictly with either resistance coefficient. In particular, a vertical magnetic field raises the absolute threshold at fixed Péclet number. Tabulated thresholds check the reduction. Algebraic elimination gives the boundary polynomial, and frequency recovery selects its physical branch. At the Darcy level the selected saddles trace an arc of the elliptic curve 11a3, a degeneration of a genus-two family at nonzero shifted levels. Series inversion on this arc gives an integer weak-throughflow series and an all-order strong-throughflow expansion. Rational certificates establish the exact convergence radii of both series on the selected sheets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Darcy-Prats问题中水平贯通流下局部扰动绝对增长的阈值：证明在Ra>π²、Pe>0时同一离轴鞍点对全程主导，给出唯一解析绝对阈值，并将结果迁移到多种阻力、各向异性、开放边界、磁场及金属泡沫换热模型，辅以级数展开和精确收敛半径。
AI.motivation: 水平贯通流不改变对流的时间起始，却会提高固定点处局部扰动增长所需的加热；因此需要确定鞍点方程五个候选鞍点中哪些真正贡献增长，并刻画绝对阈值及其在相关模型中的可迁移性。
AI.method: 从鞍点方程的五候选出发，以Fourier围道变形筛选可达鞍点；对Ra>π²、Pe>0证明同一离轴鞍点对在整个区域贡献且无Stokes转变改变其贡献。通过重标度将选择迁移到Forchheimer阻力、幂律流体横向滚、各向异性渗透率、开放上边界和垂直磁场；用同一增长函数的平移处理金属泡沫模型的相间换热。以代数消元得到边界多项式，用频率恢复选择物理分支；在Darcy层所选鞍点轨迹对应的椭圆曲线11a3弧上做级数反演，并用有理证书确定收敛半径。
AI.result: 得到由最低垂直模态首先达到的唯一解析绝对阈值；在给定贯通流下阈值随任一阻力系数严格增大，固定Péclet数时垂直磁场提高绝对阈值；列表阈值用于验证约化。Darcy层所选鞍点轨迹落在椭圆曲线11a3的弧上，该曲线是非零平移水平下亏格二族的退化；级数反演给出整数弱贯通流级数和全阶强贯通流展开，并确定两序列在所选片上的精确收敛半径。
AI.conclusion: 鞍点选择在整个研究域内保持为同一离轴对，绝对阈值具有唯一解析刻画；该框架可转移至多种扩展模型，并表明在固定Péclet数下垂直磁场会提高绝对阈值。

title: Commercial AlGaAs diodes provide simplified feedback for adaptive femtosecond pulse compression
summary: Maintaining high peak power in ultrashort laser pulses is essential for efficient nonlinear interactions, particularly in multiphoton microscopy. Dispersion introduced by optical components broadens these pulses and degrades their peak power, thus motivating adaptive pulse compression guided by pulse-width-dependent feedback. However, the conventional second-harmonic generation feedback requires a nonlinear crystal, spectral filtering, and careful optical alignment. Here, we investigate commercially available AlGaAs laser and light-emitting diodes as alternative two-photon absorption feedback sensors. Their photocurrent exhibits a quadratic dependence on average optical power and inverse dependence on pulse duration, which is consistent with the analytical model predicting maximum response for the shortest, single-peaked pulse. Both devices generated a measurable photocurrent at sub-milliwatt average power levels and showed a weaker polarization dependence than second-harmonic-generation-based solution. All three feedback methods achieved comparable mean compressed pulse durations of 210-228 fs. These results demonstrate effective adaptive pulse compression with a substantially simpler feedback.

AI.tldr: 该文研究商用 AlGaAs 激光器和发光二极管作为双光子吸收反馈传感器，以替代传统二次谐波产生反馈，实现更简单的自适应脉冲压缩；两种器件的光电流随平均光功率二次增长、随脉冲持续时间反比变化，并在低于毫瓦平均功率下可测，最终获得与二次谐波方法相当的压缩脉冲宽度（210–228 fs）。
AI.motivation: 超短激光脉冲的高峰值功率对高效非线性相互作用（尤其多光子显微镜）至关重要，但光学元件色散会展宽脉冲并降低峰值功率，因此需要以脉宽相关反馈进行自适应脉冲压缩；传统二次谐波产生反馈需要非线性晶体、光谱滤波和精细光学对准，促使作者探索更简单的反馈方案。
AI.method: 研究商用 AlGaAs 激光器和发光二极管作为双光子吸收反馈传感器，测量其光电流对平均光功率和脉冲持续时间的依赖，并与解析模型及二次谐波产生反馈方法进行比较，用于自适应脉冲压缩。
AI.result: 两种器件的光电流表现出对平均光功率的二次依赖和对脉冲持续时间的反比依赖，与预测最短、单峰脉冲响应最大的解析模型一致；在亚毫瓦平均功率下仍可产生可测光电流，且偏振依赖性弱于基于二次谐波产生的方案；三种反馈方法获得的平均压缩脉冲持续时间相当，为 210–228 fs。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，使用商用 AlGaAs 激光器和发光二极管作为双光子吸收反馈传感器，可在显著简化反馈系统的同时实现有效的自适应脉冲压缩。

title: Generation of low-frequency flows by shear Alfvén waves in magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Coherently forced, weak reduced-magnetohydrodynamic turbulence is studied in a uniform plasma to investigate the long-term nonlinear interactions of shear Alfvén waves. The 'pump waves' are chosen to model toroidal Alfvén eigenmodes, excited by suprathermal particles in magnetic fusion devices. Modes with zero frequency and no variation along the magnetic field are generated nonlinearly; these produce analogues of zonal flows and currents in a gradient-free system. This indicates that quasistationary flows can be generated by shear Alfvén waves in systems simpler than those previously considered, which relied on compressibility, finite-Larmor-radius effects, or complex geometry. The saturated amplitudes of the modes are found analytically and numerically as a function of pump-wave amplitude. This facilitates estimates of the critical amplitude above which toroidal Alfvén eigenmodes can generate sufficiently strong zonal flows to suppress microturbulence in the core of magnetic fusion devices. This threshold corresponds to magnetic fluctuations whose amplitude, relative to the background field, is comparable to $ρ_{\star i}$, the ion Larmor radius normalised to the minor radius of the device.

AI.tldr: 该文在均匀等离子体中研究相干强迫的弱约化磁流体湍流，以泵波模拟由超热粒子激发的环形阿尔芬本征模，分析剪切阿尔芬波的长期非线性相互作用，并给出零频带状流/电流的产生、饱和幅度及抑制微湍流的临界幅度估计。
AI.motivation: 研究环形阿尔芬本征模激发的剪切阿尔芬波能否通过长期非线性相互作用生成足够强的带状流，从而在磁聚变装置核心抑制微湍流；并探索在无需可压缩性、有限拉莫尔半径效应或复杂几何的简化系统中产生准稳态流的可能性。
AI.method: 采用相干强迫的弱约化磁流体湍流模型，在均匀等离子体中选取泵波模拟环形阿尔芬本征模；解析和数值计算非线性生成的零频、沿磁场无变化模式（带状流和电流的类比）的饱和幅度，并将其表示为泵波幅度的函数。
AI.result: 非线性生成了零频且沿磁场无变化的模式，形成无梯度系统中的带状流和电流类比；解析和数值得到了这些模式的饱和幅度随泵波幅度变化的依赖关系。据此可估计环形阿尔芬本征模产生足够强带状流以抑制核心微湍流的临界幅度，该阈值对应相对背景磁场的磁涨落幅度与归一化离子拉莫尔半径ρ⋆i相当。摘要未给出饱和幅度的具体函数形式及临界幅度的定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，剪切阿尔芬波可在比以往依赖可压缩性、有限拉莫尔半径效应或复杂几何的系统更简单的无梯度系统中生成准稳态带状流和电流；所建立的饱和幅度关系可用于评估环形阿尔芬本征模通过带状流抑制微湍流的临界条件，其阈值量级由ρ⋆i标定。

title: Foundation Tensor Networks Generalize Across Quantum Lattice Systems
summary: Neural quantum states and tensor networks have emerged as leading techniques for simulating quantum many-body systems. However, disordered systems remain extremely challenging in both frameworks as they require computation of the ground state for every realization of the disorder. Recently, neural quantum states have been used to construct foundation models that generate the ground state directly from the Hamiltonian. Still, they are hindered by the need to perform extensive sampling to estimate observables. To address these difficulties, we introduce the foundation tensor network (FTN), which uses a neural network to generate the tensor network representation of the ground-state wavefunction from the Hamiltonian. To accelerate training, we develop a technique, called \texttt{GridBP}, based on iterated one-dimensional belief propagation that reduces the cost of computing the energy expectation value to just two tensor contractions. We use FTNs to calculate the critical parameters of the glass transition in the quantum Edwards-Anderson model via finite-size scaling analysis. To facilitate rapid averaging, we use a moment-generating function to evaluate the order parameter, lowering the cost to a single tensor contraction. We obtain high-fidelity estimates for the critical parameters by averaging over 500,000 disorder realizations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基础张量网络（FTN），用神经网络从哈密顿量直接生成基态波函数的张量网络表示，并开发基于迭代一维置信传播的 GridBP 以加速训练；随后利用 FTN 对量子 Edwards-Anderson 模型的玻璃转变进行有限尺寸标度分析，在平均 50 万个无序实现后获得高保真的临界参数估计。
AI.motivation: 神经量子态和张量网络是模拟量子多体系统的重要方法，但无序系统极具挑战，因为需要对每个无序实现求解基态；已有的神经量子态基础模型虽能直接从哈密顿量生成基态，却受制于估计可观测量所需的大量采样。FTN 旨在同时缓解无序系统重复求解和采样开销问题。
AI.method: FTN 使用神经网络从哈密顿量生成基态波函数的张量网络表示。为加速训练，作者提出 GridBP，它基于迭代的一维置信传播，将能量期望值的计算成本降低为两次张量收缩。为便于快速平均，作者使用矩生成函数评估序参量，将成本降低为一次张量收缩。最后通过有限尺寸标度分析计算量子 Edwards-Anderson 模型中玻璃转变的临界参数。
AI.result: 作者对 500,000 个无序实现进行平均，获得了玻璃转变临界参数的高保真估计；摘要未给出具体临界参数数值。
AI.conclusion: FTN 为无序量子多体系统的基态表示与临界性质研究提供了一种高效框架，可减少传统神经量子态方法中大量采样估计可观测量的负担，并支持大规模无序平均，从而获得高精度的临界参数估计。

title: Influence of transverse oscillatory shear on the viscous fingering instability
summary: Oscillatory shear can delay the onset of viscous fingering. In addition, uniaxial translational shear also breaks the symmetry of the resulting pattern so that the interface evolves differently depending on its direction of propagation relative to the shear axis. We observe a delayed fingering onset and reduced subsequent finger growth rate for all directions as shear speed or amplitude increases. However, shear widens fingers growing in the direction perpendicular to shear and elongates those in the parallel directions. After onset, neighboring fingers in the perpendicular directions can reconnect near their base when the shear amplitude exceeds approximately five times the excess linear finger wavelength at the onset. Concentration profiles reveal smoother azimuthal edges and overlapping structures behind the tips. These observations show that shear smears individual fingers and connects neighboring ones. This correlates lateral fingering interactions with radial propagation.

AI.tldr: 研究剪切对黏性指进的影响：振荡剪切可延迟指进起始，单轴平移剪切还会破坏图案对称性，使界面演化依赖传播方向与剪切轴的相对取向；剪切速度或振幅增大时，指进起始延迟且后续指状生长速率降低。
AI.motivation: 探究振荡剪切和单轴平移剪切如何影响黏性指进的起始、指状生长及界面图案演化，特别是图案对传播方向相对于剪切轴的依赖性，以及剪切是否能改变相邻指间的相互作用。
AI.method: 对界面演化进行观察，并分析浓度剖面，比较不同剪切速度或振幅下、不同传播方向相对于剪切轴时的指进行为；摘要未提供具体实验装置、材料体系及定量参数。
AI.result: 随着剪切速度或振幅增加，所有方向上的指进起始均延迟，后续指状生长速率降低；剪切使垂直于剪切方向生长的指变宽，使平行方向生长的指被拉长。起始后，当剪切振幅超过起始时过量线性指波长约五倍时，垂直方向上的相邻指可在根部附近重新连接；浓度剖面显示更平滑的方位角边缘及指端后方重叠结构。
AI.conclusion: 剪切会抹平单个指状结构并连接相邻指，从而将横向指进相互作用与径向传播联系起来。

title: Optical Representation Neural Networks Enabled by Weakly Supervised Learning
summary: Diffractive optical neural networks (ONNs) show remarkable promise in high-speed and energy-efficient optical computing. However, most existing ONNs are optimized to reproduce predefined output intensity distributions, with the desired optical responses explicitly specified before training. Here, we introduce optical representation neural networks (ORNNs) enabled by coarse-grained weak supervision. Using handwritten Devanagari, Arabic, and English characters as three semantic groups, a modified contrastive objective encourages samples from the same script to cluster into similar optical representations. Remarkably, ORNNs improve the classification accuracy by approximately 9% over conventional supervised ONNs, while requiring only around 18% of the training steps to reach a stable test accuracy of 84.5%. These features can be selectively interpreted using corresponding semantic decoders. Building on this concept, we further realized semantic optical encryption with electronic neural network (ENN) decryption using experimentally acquired representations from a single-layer diffractive network fabricated by two-photon polymerization lithography (TPL). Here, we combine information from different scripts into a mixed optical ciphertext that is then first optically classified before being decrypted with a matched ENN. This work broadens the training paradigm of ONNs by coupling upstream optical representation learning with downstream task-specific decoding, opening new avenues for optical information processing.

AI.tldr: 提出光学表征神经网络（ORNN），以粗粒度弱监督和修改的对比目标学习光学表征，用于手写文字分类；较监督ONN精度约提升9%，仅需约18%训练步数达到84.5%稳定测试精度，并演示了基于单层衍射网络实验表征的语义光学加密与ENN解密。
AI.motivation: 现有衍射光学神经网络多被优化为复现预定义输出强度分布，训练前需明确指定目标光学响应，限制了训练范式与表征学习能力。
AI.method: 以手写天城文、阿拉伯文和英文字符为三个语义组，采用粗粒度弱监督和修改的对比目标，使同组样本聚类为相似光学表征；表征可由对应语义解码器选择性解释。进一步用双光子聚合光刻制造单层衍射网络，实验获取表征，将不同文字信息混合为光学密文，先光学分类再由匹配ENN解密。
AI.result: ORNN较传统监督ONN分类精度提高约9%，达到84.5%稳定测试精度仅需约18%训练步数；语义解码器可选择性解释表征；实验实现语义光学加密与ENN解密。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过将上游光学表征学习与下游任务特定解码耦合，拓宽了ONN训练范式，为光学信息处理提供新途径。

title: Radiation in relativistic plasmas via particle simulations
summary: We investigate radiation in relativistic electron-proton isotropic plasmas using molecular dynamics, with velocity-dependent inertia, retarded interactions, and quantum-corrected pair potentials. Radiation spectra from the Liénard-Wiechert fields agree with analytical models. Successive scattering events suppress bremsstrahlung even at weak coupling, while jitter radiation becomes comparable at higher coupling for all resolved frequencies. This first-principles framework will help develop radiation models for suppression and field effects that are inaccessible in typical particle-in-cell methods.

AI.tldr: 该文采用分子动力学研究相对论电子-质子各向同性等离子体中的辐射，引入速度依赖惯性、延迟相互作用和量子修正配对势，并由 Liénard-Wiechert 场计算辐射谱；结果表明连续散射事件会抑制轫致辐射，而抖动辐射在较高耦合下可与前者相当。
AI.motivation: 研究相对论电子-质子各向同性等离子体中的辐射过程，并建立一个第一性原理框架，以发展能够描述辐射抑制和场效应的模型，这些效应在典型粒子模拟（PIC）方法中难以处理；摘要未提供具体应用场景或参数范围。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学模拟相对论电子-质子各向同性等离子体，模型中包含速度依赖的惯性、延迟相互作用和量子修正的配对势；利用 Liénard-Wiechert 场计算辐射谱，并与解析模型进行比较。
AI.result: 由 Liénard-Wiechert 场得到的辐射谱与解析模型一致；连续散射事件即使在弱耦合下也会抑制轫致辐射，而在较高耦合下，抖动辐射在所有已分辨频率上变得与轫致辐射相当。
AI.conclusion: 该第一性原理框架有助于发展描述辐射抑制和场效应的辐射模型，并可处理典型 PIC 方法难以涵盖的效应；摘要未给出定量适用范围或未来工作的具体计划。

title: Generative Design with Real-time Physics Explainability: Towards Product Definition in the Age of AI
summary: In this article, we explore opportunities from using generative AI in mechanical engineering. On the one hand, generative methods based on invertible neural networks have been recently proposed for the solution of inverse design problems, allowing to infer design parameters from performance labels. On the other hand, generative AI models have shown that they can act as real time capable surrogates for physics based simulations. Here we suggest that these two streams should be combined in a unified framework, where INN are used to control the design process from the customer requirements perspective and the generative simulation of the systems physics adds a layer of explainability, why the proposed design fulfils the requirements. As generative design is prone to hallucinations, we propose uncertainty quantification to fend off physically infeasible requests. Finally, validation with classical tools is a requirement for generative design process. To demonstrate the capabilities of our novel generative design paradigm, we develop two interactive environments, one for airfoil design based on simulator data and one for the combustor design space exploration based on measured data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基于可逆神经网络（INN）的逆设计与生成式物理仿真代理统一起来，形成面向机械工程的生成式设计框架，并从客户需求驱动设计、提供可解释性、用不确定性量化防范不可行请求，以及用经典工具验证；通过翼型和燃烧室两个交互环境展示能力。
AI.motivation: 探索生成式AI在机械工程中的应用机会：一方面，INN已用于逆设计，可由性能标签推断设计参数；另一方面，生成式AI模型可作为物理仿真的实时代理。作者希望将这两条技术路线结合，从客户需求角度控制设计过程，并解释所提设计为何满足需求。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：用INN从客户需求出发控制设计过程，用生成式系统物理仿真增加可解释性；针对生成式设计易产生幻觉的问题，引入不确定性量化以阻挡物理上不可行的请求；并要求使用经典工具进行验证。为演示该范式，开发了两个交互环境：一个基于模拟器数据的翼型设计环境，一个基于测量数据的燃烧室设计空间探索环境。
AI.result: 作者开发了两个交互环境，用于展示所提出的生成式设计范式在翼型设计和燃烧室设计空间探索中的能力。摘要未提供定量性能、精度或实验对比结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张将INN逆设计、生成式物理仿真、不确定性量化和经典工具验证结合为统一的生成式设计流程，并认为该流程可从需求驱动设计并增强可解释性。摘要称通过两个交互环境展示了能力，但未给出具体定量结论或验证结果。

title: HydróDex: gotta match 'em all!
summary: We present a comprehensive hydrodynamic classification of stationary fluid profiles in first-order phase transitions within the constant-sound-speed model, a physically motivated extension of the standard bag model that allows the sound speeds in front of and behind the wall, $c_+$ and $c_-$, to differ. Solving the matching conditions at the bubble wall and evolving the profile in the surrounding plasma, we systematically identify and classify all the possible stationary solutions. The classification recovers all previously known direct and inverse detonation, deflagration, and hybrid solutions, while revealing a new class of stationary configurations, termed mixed hybrids, featuring rarefaction waves on both sides of the wall and oppositely directed fluid flows. For a sufficiently pronounced hierarchy $c_+ > c_-$, the classification in terms of the wall velocity $ξ_w$ and the asymptotic strength parameter $α_N$ further exhibits degenerate regions in parameter space, where multiple distinct stationary profiles correspond to the same physical inputs $(ξ_w,α_N)$. This non-uniqueness arises as the parametrization discards thermodynamic information and is resolved once the underlying microphysics is specified. We also compute the kinetic-energy budget and the associated acoustic gravitational-wave spectra within the sound-shell model, finding that mixed-hybrid solutions, despite their oppositely directed flows, introduce no additional spectral feature, and their spectra can be closely mimicked by ordinary direct or inverse hybrids with very different fluid profiles. Finally, we release HydróDex, a public code that implements the complete hydrodynamic classification, fluid-profile construction, kinetic-energy budget, and gravitational-wave calculation.

AI.tldr: 该文在允许气泡壁两侧声速不同的常声速模型中，对一阶相变中的定常流体剖面进行完整流体力学分类，发现混合杂化解与参数简并，并计算动能预算和声学引力波谱，同时发布 HydróDex 公开代码。
AI.motivation: 将标准袋模型推广为壁前、壁后声速 c+ 与 c- 可不同的更物理模型，以系统描述一阶相变气泡壁附近的定常流体剖面，并统一归类已知解、考察新解、参数简并及其引力波特征。
AI.method: 求解气泡壁处的匹配条件，并演化周围等离子体中的剖面，系统识别和分类所有定常解；在 sound-shell 模型中计算动能预算及声学引力波谱；实现并公开 HydróDex 代码，覆盖完整分类、流体剖面构建、动能预算和引力波计算。
AI.result: 分类复现所有已知的直达与反向爆轰、爆燃及混合解，并发现称为 mixed hybrids 的新定常构型，其特征是壁两侧均有稀疏波且流体流向相反。当 c+>c- 的层次足够显著时，(ξw, αN) 参数空间出现简并，同一物理输入可对应多个不同定常剖面；该非唯一性源于参数化丢弃热力学信息，指定微观物理后可消除。mixed hybrids 虽流向相反，但不引入额外谱特征，其谱可被流体剖面显著不同的普通直达或反向混合解近似。摘要未给出具体数值谱或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了常声速模型中一阶相变定常流体剖面的完整流体力学分类，揭示新解和参数简并，并说明简并需由微观物理消除；mixed hybrids 不增加可区分的声学引力波谱特征；HydróDex 为分类、剖面、动能预算和引力波计算提供公开实现。

title: Symmerty-Engineered Moire Metasurface for Multibeam Control
summary: Moiré metasurfaces offer a versatile platform for wavefront engineering through the relative rotation of periodic structures. Despite extensive demonstrations of continuous beam steering, the physical mechanisms governing beam multiplicity remain poorly understood, hindering the systematic design of multibeam radiation states. Here, we establish a predictive framework for engineering beam multiplicity in reflective moiré metasurfaces based on the dominant Fourier coefficients of their constituent patterns. We reveal that the rotational symmetry of these Fourier components in reciprocal space fully determines the symmetry of the resulting moiré unit cell and, consequently, its radiation characteristics. By further incorporating their phase information, both beam multiplicity and steering trajectories can be accurately predicted. We demonstrate this approach using reflective moiré metasurfaces constructed from patterns with p6m, p3m1, and p4m plane-group symmetries, achieving one-, two-, three-, four-, and six-beam radiation states with continuously tunable steering trajectories. Beyond symmetry-based design, we identify two additional degrees of freedom for beam multiplicity control. Selecting different rotation centers reshapes the phase distributions of the dominant Fourier coefficients, enabling further manipulation of beam multiplicity and spatial arrangement, while varying the relative twist angle alters the pairing of Fourier components, inducing transitions between distinct beam multiplicities. These findings establish a systematic framework for versatile and reconfigurable multibeam wavefront engineering.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于构成图案主导傅里叶系数的预测框架，用于设计反射式莫尔超表面的光束多重性与转向轨迹，并实现一至六光束的可重构辐射状态。
AI.motivation: 尽管莫尔超表面已广泛用于连续光束转向，但决定光束多重性的物理机制仍缺乏理解，限制了多光束辐射状态的系统化设计。
AI.method: 建立以构成图案主导傅里叶系数为核心的预测框架：利用这些分量在倒空间中的旋转对称性判定莫尔晶胞对称性及辐射特性，并结合相位信息预测光束多重性与转向轨迹；采用具有p6m、p3m1和p4m平面群对称性的图案构建反射式莫尔超表面进行演示，同时考察旋转中心与相对扭转角两个自由度。
AI.result: 实现了单光束、双光束、三光束、四光束和六光束辐射状态，且转向轨迹连续可调；不同旋转中心可重塑主导傅里叶系数的相位分布，从而调控光束多重性与空间排布；改变相对扭转角会改变傅里叶分量的配对，诱导不同光束多重性之间的转变。摘要未提供定量性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了面向多功能、可重构多光束波前工程的系统化设计框架。

title: Finite-Larmor-radius vortex interaction from δf to full-f gyrofluid dynamics
comment: 40 pages, 17 figures, submitted to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion
summary: We study finite-size electrostatic gyrofluid vortex pairs in a two-dimensional isothermal model, focusing on finite-Larmor-radius effects and the transition from local perturbative to finite-amplitude full-distribution dynamics. An effective response kernel based on Padé ion gyroaveraging regularizes the short-range Euler interaction on the Larmor-radius scale while preserving its logarithmic far field, yielding a finite- core prediction for the orbital frequency. Local-model scans show that increasing the ion temperature relative to the electron temperature enhances gyrospinning and filamentation and drives a separation-dependent transition from merger to long-lived co-rotation. Long-wavelength simulations reproduce the predicted finite-Larmor- radius-induced dip in orbital angular frequency, corresponding to a pronounced slowdown of the vortex-pair rotation. For the full-distribution regime, we introduce a quasi-neutrality-consistent initialization that reconstructs the ion gyrocenter density from prescribed electron density and electrostatic potential. It recovers the local limit at small amplitude, whereas finite-amplitude simulations reveal additional mean-density polarization vorticity, delayed or arrested merger, and a loss of density- vorticity sign symmetry already in the cold-ion full-f system. An independent sign scan of density and vorticity then shows how this nonlinear NOB asymmetry combines with the local warm-ion FLR symmetry breaking identified in earlier δf vortex studies; for warm ions, Padé-based arbitrary-wavelength NOB and NOB+LWL polarization additionally produce distinct morphologies and trajectories. These results demonstrate that nonlinear density-dependent polarization and FLR physics form separate but coupled mechanisms that can qualitatively alter elementary vortex interactions in two-dimensional gyrofluid dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文在二维等温回旋流体模型中研究有限尺寸静电涡对，重点分析有限拉莫尔半径效应以及从局部微扰到有限振幅全分布动力学的转变。
AI.motivation: 研究有限尺寸静电回旋流体涡对中有限拉莫尔半径（FLR）效应，并理解局部微扰描述向有限振幅全分布动力学过渡时的行为。
AI.method: 采用基于Padé离子回旋平均的有效响应核，在拉莫尔半径尺度上正则化短程Euler相互作用并保留对数远场；开展局部模型扫描和长波模拟；针对全分布区域，引入准中性一致初始化，由给定电子密度和静电势重构离子导向中心密度，并进行密度与涡量的独立符号扫描。
